entries.title: Psalms 138:2
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Temple - Where the ark was. He was not permitted to enter into it. Magnified - For thou hast glorified thy word or promise unto me more than any other of thy glorious perfections.

entries.title: Psalms 138:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The kings - A prophecy of the calling of the Gentiles. Hear - The gospel preached among then.

entries.title: Psalms 138:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The ways - His wonderful counsel and gracious providences.

entries.title: Psalms 138:8–139:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Perfect - Will finish the great work of my deliverance. Forsake not - Or, do not give over, the work of my salvation, which is thus far advanced, not by any human help, but by thy power and providence.
